answer.algorithm: Use a dictionary to store values already encountered and their indices.
answer.implementation: For each value, calculate target - value. If the complement is already in the dictionary, return the stored index and current index. Otherwise store the current value and continue.
answer.complexity: O(n) average time and O(n) space.
assumptions: The input contains at least one valid pair.
answer.conclusion: A hash map allows the pair to be found in one pass with O(n) average time.
